provenance.limit: changes nothing on Chromium or without animation-timeline; costs one style recalc per frame, also while idle at the end of the page (WKTR run 41045232315: 576 of 576 frames with this flag alone, 0 without)

unthrottle that cancels its flag animation after 134 ms (8 frames at 60 Hz) without scroll and restores it at the next touch start or scroll event; while parked the page is throttled on iOS again (Lean parked_throttles), so the first scroll update after a touch that follows the restore by less than one frame can still be throttled (open on the device)
same (pointer: coarse) guard as unthrottle; one frame per update while scrollY moves and 8 still frames after, so chasing parts get more frames per second than under the throttled scroll event
